latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Eraser — object removal for video clips.

- Upload your video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and request object or watermark erasure with a text prompt.
- No manual sliders or complex editing; AI handles object removal and exports a clean 1080p MP4.
- Fast cloud-based GPU rendering; typical jobs complete in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Quick setup with anonymous token support (100 free credits); automatic session creation.
- Supports exporting to various formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, etc.) with download links provided after processing.
